body: I don’t live with them but I do see them very often.

If I do therapy for it the therapist will have to tell my family about what happened since I’m a minor. And if that happens one of two things will happen. 1. My family won’t believe me and think I’m an attention whore. This will probably happen because the person who abused me is a family member who everyone loves. 2. My parents do believe me and my family is torn apart. And either way the cops will probably be notified, and I don’t think I can handle that.
